title: lupinus pilosus var. luthereaui
intro: Lupinus pilosus var. luthereaui, commonly known as Luthereau's hairy lupine, is a variety of the hairy lupine plant (Lupinus pilosus) native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. It has been found to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Luthereau's hairy lupine include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal effects, which may aid in the treatment of wounds, infections, and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
